details: Tensions between the United States and Iran are escalating following the rejection of ceasefire proposals by both sides, contributing to a rise in global oil prices. Amidst this uncertainty, Bitcoin has demonstrated resilience, maintaining its value around $80,000. Analysts are observing Bitcoin's evolving role as a "hybrid asset" during geopolitical crises, and institutional inflows into Bitcoin ETFs continue.
title: US-Iran Standoff Elevates Oil Prices, Bitcoin Holds Steady

details: A recent summit between President Trump and President Xi in Beijing, while not directly addressing digital assets, had a noticeable impact on cryptocurrency markets. Bitcoin saw a 2.3% increase to $96,800, and AI-related tokens experienced even larger gains. Discussions focused on critical issues like AI chip exports and trade tariffs, which have the potential to influence the global hash rate and the supply chain for crypto mining hardware.
title: Trump-Xi Summit Boosts Bitcoin, AI Tokens Amid Trade Talks

details: The US Senate Banking Committee is scheduled to review over 100 proposed amendments to the CLARITY Act. A primary area of contention is the regulatory treatment of yield-bearing stablecoins, with proposals seeking to impose tighter restrictions on crypto assets that function similarly to traditional deposit accounts. This legislative development is crucial for the future landscape of cryptocurrency regulation in the United States.
title: US Senate to Debate CLARITY Act Amendments, Stablecoin Rules in Focus
